```lean
induction n with d hd,
  { exact le_refl (n + 1) },
  { have h : 2 ^ d + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (d + 1) := by rw [pow_add, pow_one]; apply add_le_add_right; exact le_rfl },
  { rw [pow_add, pow_one, add_assoc],
    refine add_le_add (hd _ _) _,
    { exact le_of_lt (lt_succ d) },
    { exact le_rfl } }
```
